description: We are final-year B.Tech engineering students passionate about Space Exploration and applied software engineering. Combining skills in Web Development, AI & Machine Learning, Data Analysis, Data Visualization, and Design, we are tackling the "Create Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions" challenge. Our platform pairs predictive anomaly detection with intuitive telemetry dashboards to help deep-space crews track vitals, detect early health risks, and stay mission-ready.
